problem: After Sally takes 20 shots, she has made $55\%$ of her shots. After she takes 5 more shots, she raises her percentage to $56\%$. How many of the last 5 shots did she make?
solution_to_review: If Sally makes $55\%$ of her 20 shots, she makes $0.55 \times 20 = 12$ shots. If Sally makes $56\%$ of her 25 shots, she makes $0.56 \times 25 = 13$ shots. So she makes $13-12=\boxed{1}$ of the last 5 shots.
